artDirection: Premium painted HD-2D fantasy tactical RPG departure from refuge into the canonical reserve-trail landscape. Restore forward motion, reveal a vulnerable convoy and distant smoke toward Bois-Clair, but leave the reserve dilemma unresolved.

shots.purpose: Establish the company leaving refuge and reading the troubled road ahead.
shots.promptIntent: Maelor takes only a few measured steps while Kestrel remains screen-right-facing toward the smoke horizon. Preserve their sides and do not make Kestrel fire or threaten anyone. Show subtle wagon, dust, smoke, and cloth movement without resolving the convoy dilemma.

shots.purpose: Bring the convoy pressure and the smoke toward Bois-Clair into a more immediate two-shot.
shots.promptIntent: Kestrel registers the distant smoke with a small head movement while Maelor studies the convoy to his screen-left. Lock Kestrel to screen-right. Lock Maelor's head, shoulders, torso, hips, feet, book, and dagger to screen-left for the entire shot; he must never rotate or look toward screen-right. Keep bow, arrow, hands, book, and dagger stable. No supplies change hands, no attack begins, and no route or moral choice is made.

shots.purpose: Continue the reviewed convoy frame into a neutral dialogue-ready hold.
shots.promptIntent: Continue from the reviewed last frame with restrained breathing, dust, smoke, wagon canvas, and cloth movement. Lock the camera completely: no zoom, push, pull, pan, track, crop, reframing, parallax, or subject-scale change. Preserve identity, weapons, sides, and facing. End sharp and neutral; do not show a transaction, threat, selection, victory, or consequence.
